ruleDefinitions.name: New Root or CA or AuthRoot Certificate to Store
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the addition of new root, CA or AuthRoot certificates to the Windows registry Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\SystemCertificates\\\\Root\\\\Certificates\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\SystemCertificates\\\\Root\\\\Certificates\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\EnterpriseCertificates\\\\Root\\\\Certificates\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\SystemCertificates\\\\CA\\\\Certificates\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\SystemCertificates\\\\CA\\\\Certificates\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\EnterpriseCertificates\\\\CA\\\\Certificates\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\SystemCertificates\\\\AuthRoot\\\\Certificates\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\SystemCertificates\\\\AuthRoot\\\\Certificates\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\EnterpriseCertificates\\\\AuthRoot\\\\Certificates\\\\.*")) AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Blob$") AND Details = "Binary\ Data")
